item.title: [HIGH] Fedora: fuse-overlayfs-1.17-1.fc44 (FEDORA-2026-4e0490640f)
item.description: Update to fuse-overlayfs 1.17 to fix CVE-2026-52791: privilege escalation via SUID/SGID bit preservation on file truncation. When a file with SUID/SGID bits is truncated, those privilege bits should be cleared but were not in versions prior to 1.17, allowing potential privilege escalation in rootless containers.

[MEDIUM] CVE-2026-16743: A flaw was found in accountsservice. The systemd-homed code path for SetIconFile...
item.description: A flaw was found in accountsservice. The systemd-homed code path for SetIconFile opens a user-supplied filename as root without the validation and privilege drop performed by the classic handler. A local attacker with a systemd-homed-managed account can read arbitrary files accessible to the accounts-daemon process.
